about_the_game:
Welcome to Bubbleon, a clean, bubbly, and vibrant planet, where its inhabitants, the Bubbleons, live in complete harmony!

Or so it seemed, as everything changed when the Odorax, creatures adapted to toxic and corrosive worlds, crossed a rift in space-time and began invading Bubbleon, contaminating its delicate ecosystem with their mere presence. Now, the planet needs a creative hero to restore order and bring cleanliness and peace back to its inhabitants!

Play as Noah, an operative from a species known for its slowness, but extremely skilled thanks to his high-tech equipment. In this adventure, brute force is of no use: you must use your ingenuity and futuristic tools to resolve conflicts nonviolently and contain the Odorax while cleaning up the mess they've left behind.

Your tools include:

Bubble Traps: Place them strategically to trap the Odorax without harming them.

Sleep Gas: Induces a sleep state in groups of enemies, ideal for escaping or gaining an advantage.

Vacuum Belt: Multi-purpose; cleans contamination, heals Bubbleons, and manipulates the environment to your advantage.

Time Lapse: Noah's special ability that allows him to manipulate time, dodge attacks, solve puzzles, and create unique opportunities.

Claws: Interact with environmental elements, break obstacles, and activate mechanisms to advance the adventure.

Explore a world full of bubbling secrets, challenging puzzles, and vibrant environments that combine 3D platforming, exploration, and puzzle-solving. Every corner of Bubbleon is designed to surprise you and offer opportunities for creative play.

Inspired by titles like Ratchet & Clank and High on Life, Noah & The Cosmic Cleanup combines humor, science fiction, and emergent storytelling, making each absurd situation feel unique and fun. Noah may seem lazy, but his ingenuity and determination make him an unlikely hero, able to face any challenge with creativity and humor.

Get ready to jump, run, manipulate time, and use an arsenal of tools in a cosmic adventure where cleanup is the real mission. Bubbleon needs a hero… and that hero is you.
